text:
nina: FYI discovered potential memory exposure in hsm-agent during rewrap flow. jmptools memdump shows unmapped pages after unwrap. tagging eng-security.

alex: can you share an abbreviated repro? is this on-staging only?

nina: gist: https://internal.gists/35f2 (quick paste)

# repro steps
1) deploy hsm-agent v1.3.2
2) run kmstool unwrap with --attest
3) observe /proc/<pid>/smaps shows RW anon pages not mlocked

maria: urgent: this could leak KEK fragments to core dumps/swap. Is swap enabled on bastion?

nina: swap is enabled on older bastion AMI. Prod bastions (newer) have swap disabled. Staging had swap on.

sam: triage plan: (a) verify if any core dumps exist (b) ensure helper process calls mlockall(MCL_CURRENT|MCL_FUTURE) (c) add unit test to ensure /proc/self/smaps contains no anonymous writable pages after unwrap.

alex: agree. Also add runtime guard: if swap on -> refuse to run unless JIT role `rewrap-emergency` is provisioned and `byok_emergency_optin=true`. We should fail-safe.

maria: RBAC question: do we require extra approver for runs on hosts with swap? I'd say yes, two-person auth. Ops/Oncall cannot unilaterally run rewrap on swapped hosts.

nina: quick patch idea — wrap helper runs in setuid root container that mlocks and uses shm-only tempfs. Pseudocode:
```c
// call before loading key material
if (mlockall(MCL_CURRENT | MCL_FUTURE) != 0) {
  fprintf(stderr, "mlock failed\n");
  return EXIT_FAILURE;
}
// set tmpfs mount for ephemeral metadata
```

sam: security note: container runtime must run with CAP_IPC_LOCK and no writeable mounts. Add seccomp profile.

security-bot: Flagged: CVE-XXXX-YYYY (internal) created for "hsm-agent: potential memory leakage to swap/core". Assigned to @nina. Priority: P1.

maria: audit logging: every attempt must emit event_type=unwrap_attempt, fields: operator, approver, host_ami, swap_enabled, agent_version, metadata_sha256, siem_forward=true. Retain at highest fidelity for 7y if customer is enterprise BYOK.

alex: KMS integration bit: ensure KEK never exits HSM in plaintext. Use HSM-side unwrap into TEEs or HSM key-wrapping-to-key pattern. If helper is used, enforce in-memory-only buffer, mlock, zeroize. Add static analysis check for memset_s usage.

nina: I'll push a small branch that mlocks and refuses to run on swap hosts. Also adding an integration test that simulates swap and expects non-zero exit.

sam: approve. Also add CI job that runs fuzzing around memory paths and a nightly health check that verifies agent binary signature and running mlock state.

maria: compliance: any emergency run on swapped host requires legal opt-in from the customer or PD-approved incident tag. Also must notify customer post-mortem within 24h.

security-bot: Note: policy BYOK-3 updated draft requiring mlocked helpers. See https://policies/internal/byok-3-draft.

nina: patch PR: https://git.internal/r/hsm-agent/pull/987 - includes mlock + tmpfs + seccomp. Will add tests after review.

alex: schedule: hotfix to staging today, prod rollout after one successful drill and signoff from compliance. Add drill to quarterly runbook.

maria: will coordinate compliance signoff and update customer contract templates with clarified opt-in language.

sam: one more for vuln triage: run a global search for other binaries that do unwrap operations and ensure they mlock. Create ticket: INFRA-7234.

nina: created INFRA-7234 and tagged owners. closing thread; will update when PR merges. :white_check_mark:
